name: Hildune's Secret Refuge (place)
summary: Hildune's Secret Refuge is a cave in northeastern Rivenspire, west of Northpoint containing Montclair soldiers. It can be accessed via a trapdoor in an abandoned house in Northsalt Village. This location contains a Skyshard, as well as the notes, I Saw Him Again Tonight, Tonight Was the Night, Nadafa's Journal (which triggers the quest Love Lost), and Tonight He Confessed. The note Hildune's Secret Refuge can be found outside the house containing the delve. Rats are found in numbers within.
